Nami: Delay and repeat gas gauge detection Currently, battery gas gauges are detected only once at HOOK_INIT. This is too early when a battery wakes up from cutoff. This patch makes EC detect gas gauges when needed. On Nami this is when the power button task checks power readiness. The power button task then repeatedly performs this check until a gauge wakes up. hwid: Hide YAML details from the database class `cros.factory.hwid.v3.database.Database` supplies methods to manipulate the HWID database object. However, to enhance the readability of HWID changes, we would like to keep the order of the keys of dictionaries in the HWID database. Previously we implemented such feature in `cros.factory.hwid.v3.database` object and caused that module contains too much detail about how a HWID database object is loaded/dumped from/to a YAML formatted text. This CL moves those logic into `cros.factory.hwid.v3.yaml_wrapper` so that the `Database` class can only focus on verifying the content of a HWID database. login: Add ability to delete component policy If StoreUnsignedPolicyEx() is called with an empty policy blob and the policy descriptor specifies component policy, the policy is deleted from disk. This will allow authpolicyd to clean up stale extension policy. Deleting should not be extended to Chrome policy or signed policy for security reasons, e.g. a Chrome hack could just delete signed policy.
